strandSteps.interaction: Early: discover a specific discrepancy through the existing waypost/crossing or town-office notice. Use reading, a willing teacher or existing Perception-3 deduction when those native actions remain unfinished. An already knowledgeable traveler receives a new question, not another reward.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: An attributed question and known observation places. Reuse `village.routeKnown`/first `routeOrigin`, `campaign.anchor` and actual town records. A town-timber contributor can still pursue new field work; their old timber choice remains true.

strandSteps.interaction: Established: compare two physical observations, one at a known Village crossing/road point and one at Forest road or the unlocked cave entrance. First-pass proposal: each new comparison takes 5 played minutes and 2 stamina; consulting an offered report is free but remains reported evidence.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: A small dossier records place, time, firsthand/reported basis and the limit of the observation. New campaign records use existing knowledge/receipt owners. No passive bestiary counter, report or menu grants a discovery as if personally seen.

strandSteps.interaction: Established: choose preparation for a known question. A personal footing task can use rope/Climbing or earned Rat-step; a loaded task uses real kit, ordinary handling or compatible Load-bearing Step. Native Forest wolves and cave-room rats invite different equipment and recovery plans.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: Two usable plans with different material/time/body needs, known reasons when blocked, and a lawful return point. The actual action determines applicability; a narrow-footwork source never gains cargo capacity from this dossier.

strandSteps.interaction: Mature: undertake the actual outward journey, finish a local comparison or safely decline the off-path work, then return with an actionable observation. Town's existing survey can contribute its own result if actually performed; a new dossier must not award its six-coin settlement again.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: One tested safe approach, an accurately qualified danger boundary or a deliberate incomplete map changes a later local action: choose the usable staging point, prepare the appropriate kit, or close the unsuitable order. Safe-road/entrance work is a viable completion route. Native travel remains travel, including Running modifiers.

strandSteps.interaction: Mature return: give the actual dossier to a willing resident, keep it for home preparation or withdraw an earlier unsupported recommendation. A recipient executes one funded local trial using their own means.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: A useful return/hand-off and a changed firsthand meeting. A correction preserves earlier evidence and marks it superseded; it does not rewrite the player's native quest history. The resident's result is offered later, not live private telemetry.

strandSteps.interaction: Early: hear the resident's work question and known risk; inspect native equipment, health/stamina, available tools and the actual safe-parent fallback. Existing `field.assess` can establish a voluntary trial; it remains its own once-only assessment.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: A protection plan names who works, who can leave and what is being protected. Listening grants no source, combat skill or job acceptance. New co-located proposal/consent content; no global patrol rewrite.

strandSteps.interaction: Established ordinary route: survey from the safe parent, reschedule for an inspected condition or accept a smaller supported observation. Supply a real kit and funded worker effort.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: A narrower useful result with no fought encounter and less reach. New bounded job and compatible local observation effect; it does not mark a native zone cleared. The same campaign can mature through competent ordinary organization.

strandSteps.interaction: Established combat route: voluntarily enter the actual unlocked Cave room or Forest and complete a declared post-acceptance native encounter while the observer stays at the safe parent. Recover and return before consenting to their work.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: Actual native combat, loot/XP/recovery and a new attributed encounter receipt permit one supervised edge-observation job from the safe parent. The observer never enters the repeating combat zone and the receipt suppresses no native spawns. Engine must freeze zone/count baseline at acceptance and consume a once-only contribution receipt from the native result callback. Old clearance cannot be paid again; one encounter is not proof the whole forest is safe.

strandSteps.interaction: Trained control route: apply ordinary stance, measured focus or mastered breath drive to a compatible loaded observation frame at the safe staging point. First-pass new assessment has a controlled shove and a hold/release decision; it is separate from `field.assess`.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: A frame remains stable, is deliberately released safely or requires a smaller test. Use existing source/power/energy/body checks and paid participant reservation. No new stun, taunt, monster binding, shield technique or player-owned Lio method is presumed.

strandSteps.interaction: Mature: complete one real workday under the chosen protection plan, pay/transfer its output, then teach a willing resident the ordinary stop procedure or hand off a fully funded second job. Decline or safely terminate future protection if desired.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: Independent resident competence, useful output and a remembered plan that changes their next offer. A failed/withdrawn protection attempt leaves a smaller safe-parent job or a later funded retry; native injury recovery remains authoritative. No forced life reset or second prestige.

strandSteps.interaction: Early acquisition: choose an actual source. Existing Rat-step uses field-edge observation or native Starving-wolf-rat victory, then paid study; Load-bearing Step uses a willing co-located craftsman or the specifically acquired/demonstrated imprint route. Existing reading/teacher/deduction still teach ordinary route knowledge.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: Record first source and what was learned. Observing, hearing, copying, inherited Natural balance and trained Conditioned grip are distinct. No source appears from showing a trainer or ability menu.

strandSteps.interaction: Established training: preserve Rat-step's ownership at 2, execution at 6 with Agility 8, and cap 12. Slow six-minute practice and optional saved decisions reach the same method. Load-bearing Step's paid two-minute lesson teaches mastery 1; its once-only two-minute/one-stamina application raises it to 2.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: Existing execution opens only at actual requirements. Recover hands/energy and resume known controls. Native Running/Climbing/Equilibrium/Perception keep their own XP/milestones; new campaign practice cannot add a mirror mastery XP bar.

strandSteps.interaction: Established application: use a taught method on a compatible real task, then record its result. A new light-footing trial serves characters who already finished the crossing; a new loaded-frame trial serves those who already used the loose-bank response. First-pass proposal: 6 minutes/2 stamina for light footing, or 4 minutes with the chosen actual field energy for the frame; both accept ordinary slower alternatives.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: New application definitions/receipts are required. Rat-step moves the player's unloaded body across authored footing; Load-bearing Step steadies the actual load within its capacity. Neither repeats old survey/road rewards, grants every technique nor treats memory as a usable body.

strandSteps.interaction: Mature feat: make one reliable compatible outcome and explain its boundary. Rat-step 12 already guarantees its original ready-guide outcome when that route is still unfinished; propose a new repeatable precision trial that permits a reliable mastered footing result for progressed saves. Load-bearing Step 2 already supports three-output drive; propose a frame test requiring that output or a correctly chosen ordinary multi-person plan.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: The feat opens a specific useful practice/work action or a funded teaching appointment. Its completion is once per authored feat, independently of the repeatable work. Old source/mastery can satisfy prerequisites but does not fabricate having performed the new feat. Numerical gates beyond inspected existing values stay proposals until Ability/Engine freeze callers.

strandSteps.interaction: Mature insight/teaching: compare one actual success with one deliberately chosen limitation test, safe abort or honest observed failure. Record why a source/target/control condition mattered. Teach a consenting resident the ordinary portion, or keep the personal practice and close teaching.
strandSteps.resultAndDependency: A bounded insight may unlock the compatible improved application; the learner pays real attention/time/tools and owns their own operation. Method/power transfer occurs only through a delivered source-specific teaching adapter. Teaching Rat-step to arbitrary NPC bodies or granting Lio's interposition to the player is optional, not assumed.

endingCases.closureAndRevisit: Stronger function can remove a real bottleneck; future capacity still depends on actual means

endingCases.aftermath: Personal practice, tested procedure and elective paying customers; not compulsory management
endingCases.closureAndRevisit: Native gathering/trade/rest and new funded specialist work continue; personal method survives service closure

endingCases.cumulativeCause: Producer/receiver chooses an actual paid exclusive agreement, or player negotiates that route with evidence/consent rather than preventing it
endingCases.aftermath: Public capacity narrows/closes, but a legitimate private career/service continues. Relationships retain specific agreements
endingCases.closureAndRevisit: No universal villain penalty or duel erases the contract; later reopening needs parties' new consent

endingCases.cumulativeCause: Actual funded attempt fails or a signed obligation is terminated under disclosed terms; retain paid costs and witnessed result
endingCases.aftermath: Counter closes for this charter, trained methods/observations/home/native livelihoods survive; narrow repair/retry may exist
endingCases.closureAndRevisit: Terminal record cannot be reset by field renewal. A future project is a new funded cause, not undoing failure or awarding missed wages

endingCases.cumulativeCause: Learner owns one taught ordinary operation and actual tools/body/fuel, consents, receives finite funds/stock and completes a supported independent contribution
endingCases.aftermath: Resident has a genuine capability, player can explore or retire from management; limited continuing service and remembered lineage
endingCases.closureAndRevisit: Report only known results. Funds/access loss can pause the next task without erasing teaching; handoff is not NPC/player cloning

endingCases.cumulativeCause: Local duties are settled/declined/terminated; chosen actual exit/native journey costs and terms are known
endingCases.aftermath: The campaign remains with its agreements/stock/methods. Player can keep home, visit another supported place or simply stop managing
endingCases.closureAndRevisit: On return, actual known changes and last reports are distinguished. No new off-screen aging/loss/death or extraction timer is inferred
